spec.title: KITTY KONG
spec.oneLiner: Climb three perilous construction towers, leap rolling barrels, and rescue the kitten at the top.
mechanics: The player controls one worker across five sloped girders; LEFT/RIGHT walks and UP/DOWN climbs only when aligned with a usable ladder.

Press A to jump. A full hold reaches about 32 pixels of height over roughly 0.64 seconds; releasing early shortens ascent. A 0.10-second grounded coyote/buffer window makes ladder exits and girder edges forgiving.

A gorilla telegraphs each throw, then releases barrels that roll downhill, bounce at edges, and occasionally descend a usable ladder. Barrels remain dangerous until they leave the playfield or enter the oil drum.
Jumping completely over each barrel scores 100 once per barrel and player, with a bright jump-over flash; landing, walking, and climbing remain possible after the jump.

Reaching a previously unreached floor awards 100 once per stage. The kitten cage on the top-right girder is the rescue goal; touching it completes the stage and awards the remaining time bonus plus 1000 points.

Each stage has a 100-second timer, three lives, and a brief protected respawn at the highest floor reached after a barrel, fire, fall, or timeout hit. The player loses a life and the current life restarts; zero lives ends the game.

Stage 1 teaches steady barrels, stage 2 increases barrel cadence and adds limited fire hazards, and stage 3 combines faster barrels, more ladder drops, and bounded fire placement while preserving recovery gaps.

After the third kitten rescue, show the final score and win state. Reset the stage timer, hazard schedule, floor progress, and one-time scoring IDs on each new stage or life restart; use a fixed seed for repeatable barrel paths.
spec.artDirection: 256x224 construction-site arcade scene with a 44-pixel-tall worker in bright overalls and a distinct hard hat, readable idle, walking, climbing, jumping, hurt, and death poses. Five thick sloped girders fill the playfield, with contrasting ladders, dark gaps, orange barrel highlights, warning lights, and a large animated gorilla silhouette at upper-left. The kitten is a small but high-contrast white-and-pink sprite in a cage at the top-right, changing to an excited rescued pose. Keep the background muted steel-blue and charcoal so the worker, barrels, ladders, and kitten read clearly on the fixed 16-colour palette.

preserve: Construction-tower climbing with sloped girders and ladders
A gorilla at the upper-left throwing rolling barrels
A kitten trapped in a cage at the top
Lives, timer pressure, stage progression, and rescue completion
change: Use the requested single-player version against computer-controlled hazards; do not include cooperative two-player play

controls.left: Walk left while grounded; steer in air.
controls.right: Walk right while grounded; steer in air.
controls.up: Climb upward when centered at a ladder; otherwise no effect.
controls.down: Climb downward when centered at a ladder; otherwise no effect.
controls.a: Jump while grounded or within the brief coyote window; holding gives full height, releasing early shortens it.

spec.lose: Lose one life from a barrel, fire hazard, fall, or timer expiry; game over when all three lives are exhausted.
spec.scoring: Score 100 for each unique barrel jumped, 100 for each newly reached floor, 1000 per kitten rescue, plus the remaining timer bonus; stage-clear scoring cannot repeat.
